Taken together, the theorem highlights why NFT struggles in over-parameterized models: certification forces the injection of noise into all coordinates at each step. This motivates our adaptation based on sequential subspace injection , where the same noise budget is redistributed across orthogonal subspaces instead of being applied globally. Independent of how noise is injected, certified unlearning methods whose guarantees are formulated in a training-agnostic, worst-case manner must account for arbitrary model initializations, which can make it impossible to guarantee both good performance and faster-than-retraining unlearning.
